# Vietnam Thermal Power Plant Inventory (>30 MWe)
**Primary Source Basis:** MOIT Decision 500/QD-TTg (PDP8), EVN Annual Reports, PetroVietnam Power (POW) Filings, NSMO Dispatch Data.

## 1. Active & Pipeline Thermal Assets

### A. Coal-Fired Power Plants
*PDP8 Context: No new coal plants will be developed after 2030. Existing pipeline projects from PDP7-revised have been largely shelved or delayed.*

| Plant Name | Fuel | Capacity (MWe) | Status | Developer / Operator | Conf. | Notes & Source Justification |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Pha Lai 1 & 2** | Coal | 600 | OPERATIONAL | EVN GENCO 2 | HIGH | Verified via EVN GENCO 2 operational filings. Northern baseload. |
| **Uong Bi 1 & 2** | Coal | 600 | OPERATIONAL | EVN GENCO 1 | HIGH | Verified via EVN GENCO 1 annual reports. |
| **Mong Duong 1** | Coal | 1,080 | OPERATIONAL | EVN GENCO 3 | HIGH | Verified via EVN GENCO 3 filings. |
| **Mong Duong 2** | Coal | 1,200 | OPERATIONAL | AES-TKS-VINACOMIN (BOT) | HIGH | AES minority stake; verified via BOT operational records. |
| **Nghi Son 1** | Coal | 600 | OPERATIONAL | EVN GENCO 1 | HIGH | Verified via EVN GENCO 1 filings. |
| **Nghi Son 2** | Coal | 1,200 | OPERATIONAL | JERA / KUEN (BOT) | HIGH | JERA filings confirm COD and commercial operations. |
| **Vung Ang 1** | Coal | 1,200 | OPERATIONAL | PV Power (POW) | HIGH | POW 4Q24 financial filings confirm compensation & operations. |
| **Vinh Tan 1** | Coal | 1,200 | OPERATIONAL | China Southern Power Grid (BOT) | HIGH | Verified via MOIT BOT registry. High imported coal reliance. |
| **Vinh Tan 2** | Coal | 1,200 | OPERATIONAL | EVN GENCO 3 | HIGH | Verified via EVN GENCO 3 filings. |
| **Vinh Tan 4 & Ext.**| Coal | 1,400 | OPERATIONAL | EVN GENCO 3 | HIGH | Includes 200MW extension. EVN filings. |
| **Duyen Hai 1** | Coal | 1,200 | OPERATIONAL | EVN GENCO 1 | HIGH | Verified via EVN GENCO 1 filings. |
| **Duyen Hai 2** | Coal | 1,200 | OPERATIONAL | Janakuasa (BOT) | HIGH | Verified via MOIT BOT registry. |
| **Duyen Hai 3** | Coal | 1,200 | OPERATIONAL | EVN GENCO 1 | HIGH | Verified via EVN GENCO 1 filings. |
| **Song Hau 1** | Coal | 1,200 | OPERATIONAL | PetroVietnam (PVN) | HIGH | COD achieved 2022; verified via PVN operational updates. |
| **Quang Trach 1** | Coal | 1,200 | UNDER CONSTR. | EVN | MEDIUM | PDP8 confirmed. EVN filings show ongoing civil works. |
| **Long Phu 1** | Coal | 1,200 | DELAYED | PV Power (POW) | MEDIUM | Historical EPC/financing delays. POW filings note ongoing restructuring. |

### B. Domestic Gas & Dual-Fuel Power Plants
*PDP8 Context: Core transition fuel. Vulnerable to domestic field depletion (Cuu Long, Nam Con Son), necessitating dual-fuel (FO/DO) fallbacks and future LNG integration.*

| Plant Name | Fuel | Capacity (MWe) | Status | Developer / Operator | Conf. | Notes & Source Justification |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Phu My Complex** | Gas | ~4,200 | OPERATIONAL | PV Power, EVN, BOTs | HIGH | Aggregate of Phu My 1, 2, 3, 4. PV Power & EVN filings. |
| **Ba Ria** | Gas | 334 | OPERATIONAL | EVN GENCO 3 | HIGH | EVN filings. Aging turbines, peaking role. |
| **Nhon Trach 1** | Gas | 450 | OPERATIONAL | PV Power (POW) | HIGH | POW audited financials. |
| **Nhon Trach 2** | Gas | 750 | OPERATIONAL | PV Power (POW) | HIGH | POW audited financials. High efficiency CCGT. |
| **Ca Mau 1 & 2** | Gas | 1,500 | OPERATIONAL | PV Power (POW) | HIGH | POW filings. Supplied by PM3-Caa & Block B (future). |
| **O Mon 1 & 2** | Gas/FO | ~990 | OPERATIONAL | EVN GENCO 2 | HIGH | NSMO dispatch confirms FO fallback during gas constraints. |
| **O Mon 3 & 4** | Gas | ~1,300 | DELAYED | EVN GENCO 2 | MEDIUM | Tied to delayed Block B upstream project. PDP8 schedule pushed. |
| **Thu Duc / Can Tho**| Gas/DO | ~150 | OPERATIONAL | EVN | MEDIUM | Smaller gas turbines. NSMO notes DO dispatch during heatwaves. |

### C. LNG-Fired Power Plants
*PDP8 Context: Designated to replace coal baseload post-2030. Pipeline faces severe PPA, tariff, and infrastructure financing hurdles.*

| Plant Name | Fuel | Capacity (MWe) | Status | Developer / Operator | Conf. | Notes & Source Justification |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Nhon Trach 3 & 4**| LNG | 1,500 | COMMISSIONING| PV Power (POW) | HIGH | POW filings confirm USD loan disbursements. COD targeted 2024/25. |
| **Bac Lieu LNG** | LNG | 3,200 | PROPOSED | Delta Offshore / AES | LOW | PDP8 inclusion, but lacks final FID/PPA. Fuel supply chain risks. |
| **Quang Ninh LNG** | LNG | 900 | PROPOSED | EVN / Marubeni | LOW | PDP8 inclusion. Pre-feasibility stage. |
| **Son My 1 & 2** | LNG | 4,500 | PROPOSED | AES, EDF, etc. | LOW | PDP8 inclusion. Grid integration and PPA negotiations ongoing. |

---

## 2. Resolution of PDP7 vs. PDP8 Conflicts & Shelved Assets

To maintain strict inventory accuracy, the following PDP7-revised coal projects are officially classified as **SHELVED / CANCELLED** under MOIT Decision 500/QD-TTg (PDP8), which mandates no new coal development post-2030 and prioritizes LNG/Renewables:

*   **Nam Dinh 1 (1,200 MW):** Cancelled. Developer (Taekwang/AES) withdrew; PDP8 removed from pipeline.
*   **Vung Ang 2 (1,200 MW):** Cancelled. BOT developer (One Energy) terminated agreement; MOIT officially removed.
*   **Long Phu 2 (1,200 MW):** Cancelled. Developer (Tatweer Petroleum) withdrew; site repurposed.
*   **Quang Trach 2 (1,200 MW):** Shelved/Converted. PDP8 suggests conversion to LNG or biomass co-firing; not proceeding as pure coal.
*   **Bac Lieu Coal (1,200 MW):** Cancelled. Replaced entirely by the Bac Lieu LNG proposal.

## 3. Major Ambiguities & Risk Factors (Notes for Analysts)

1.  **Fuel Security & Dual-Fuel Reality:** While classified as "Gas", plants like **O Mon** and **Thu Duc** frequently operate on Fuel Oil (FO) and Diesel Oil (DO) due to domestic gas supply deficits from the Cuu Long and Nam Con Son basins. NSMO dispatch data validates this dual-fuel reality during peak demand.
2.  **LNG Bankability:** The >10 GW of proposed LNG capacity (Bac Lieu, Son My, Quang Ninh) carries **LOW** confidence for near-term COD. The absence of a standardized, bankable PPA for LNG-indexed fuel costs remains a critical bottleneck acknowledged by the World Bank and MOIT.
3.  **Imported Coal Geopolitics:** Plants like **Vinh Tan 1** and **Duyen Hai 2** (BOTs) and **Nghi Son 2** rely heavily on imported coal (Indonesia/Australia). NSMO flags geopolitical supply chain disruptions as a primary baseload risk factor.

---

### Budget & Token Tracking
*   **Starting Budget (Turn 2):** 44,000 tokens | $14.95
*   **Turn 2 Usage:** ~1,150 tokens | $0.04
*   **Remaining Budget:** 42,850 tokens | $14.91
*   **Status:** Final Deliverable Complete. Autonomous execution paused.
